description: Sends the user's inquiry (buy, rent, business, advice) to the Antarum team by e-mail. For when the user has seen the exact inquiry and their e-mail address and agreed to send it. Antarum answers by e-mail (rentals within 24 hours Monday to Friday, otherwise within 1 to 2 business days), free of charge. Returns a reference number.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code or name of the country.

email.description: The user's e-mail address for the answer.

message.description: What the user wants, in their words (at least 10 characters).

robot.description: Id or name of the robot, if any.

share_with_partners.description: Whether the user allows Antarum to pass the inquiry to a matching dealer or rental firm. Default: false.

name: send_inquiry
title: Send an inquiry to Antarum
